caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench rendered in simple black lines on a beige background. The bench features a rectangular seat, two armrests, and a backrest with a decorative upper rail that has a wavy pattern along its top edge. The backrest also includes a row of seven evenly spaced vertical balusters with symmetrical, ornate shapes. The seat of the bench is plain and flat, while the lower front rail has a scalloped edge that mirrors the wavy design of the upper back rail. The bench stands on four straight legs, one at each corner, and additional horizontal support rails connect the legs near the base. There are also two diagonal support braces extending from the front legs to the underside of the bench. The entire drawing is minimalist, consisting only of outlines and basic shading without any filled color, giving it a monochromatic appearance focused on the bench's structure and decorative details.
title: Church Pew
